warm.reindex.noop.ms.small.why: a re-index that finds nothing new re-walks the history instead of skipping it, so the noop path costs a whole walk. ADR-004 §11 budgets it at 10 ms p95 — `ctrl-r` twice must not feel like work. `e1.12` measured 49.2 ms and filed reco-7tc; this gate measures 46–60 ms on the same fixture, run to run. Recorded rather than smoothed over: 70 ms is the ceiling it may not grow past (80.5 ms with the run-to-run tolerance), and this entry is deleted by hand the day reco-7tc closes, which is when the 10 ms budget starts gating again.
